name: phone_status
description: Read phone connection, ownership and task queue. Does not read phone contents.

name: phone_submit
description: Queue the phone part of your authorized task under your own agent identity. This does not dispatch to another agent.

name: phone_wait
description: Wait up to 20 seconds for your next task and exclusive phone control. If waiting, stop phone actions and wait again when appropriate. After a new lease always observe before acting.

name: phone_tools
description: Read actual Mobile MCP tool schemas while holding the phone lease.

name: phone_call
description: Call a listed phone tool under the current lease. Observe before every input; use fresh coordinates, never refs. On any error observe again, never replay an uncertain input.

name: phone_checkpoint
description: Save completed progress and describe the next phone action so the user can understand and interrupt it.

name: phone_finish
description: Record verified results or a specific blocker and release the phone. Never claim success from a tool acknowledgement alone.
